title: Architect
description:
Architect SPOC (Modular Prefabricated Steel Structures)
Location: Bangalore, India
Experience: 45 Years
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Director
About Verbarq Pvt. Ltd.
Verbarq is an architecture and designbuild studio focused on thoughtful, execution-driven environments across residential and hospitality domains. As part of our expansion, we are developing a vertical centered on modular prefabricated steel structures designed for scalable applications such as farmhouses, hospitality units, campsites, and rapid-deployment environments.
This vertical requires architectural leadership that bridges design intent, engineering coordination, vendor engagement, and on-ground execution, ensuring seamless translation from concept to installation.
Position Overview
We are seeking an Architect with 45 years of experience, including exposure to steel structures or prefabricated construction systems, to take on a Single Point of Contact (SPOC) role for this vertical.
The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end coordination, communication, and execution oversight, acting as the central link between internal teams, consultants, fabricators, and site stakeholders. This role combines spatial planning, technical understanding, and operational coordination and is suited to someone comfortable taking ownership across the lifecycle of modular architectural delivery.
Key Responsibilities
SPOC & Coordination Leadership
Act as the primary point of contact for projects within the prefab steel vertical.
Coordinate between design teams, structural engineers, vendors, fabricators, and site teams.
Manage information flow, timelines, and decision tracking across stakeholders.
Ensure alignment between architectural intent, engineering constraints, and execution realities.
Spatial Planning & Design Development
Develop and refine space planning solutions within modular steel structural systems.
Translate system grids and structural logic into functional layouts.
Support architectural concept development aligned with prefabrication requirements.
Produce drawings, layouts, and presentations for internal and external coordination.
Technical Documentation
Prepare and review working drawings and coordination packages.
Ensure integration of architectural, structural, and service inputs.
Maintain clarity and accuracy in documentation used for fabrication and assembly.
Execution Oversight
Monitor prototype, fabrication, and installation stages.
Conduct site visits to review assembly quality and adherence to design intent.
Identify coordination issues early and facilitate resolution.
Track progress and provide updates to leadership.
Process & System Development
Contribute to establishing workflows, templates, and documentation standards for the vertical.
Support the creation of reusable planning modules and design guidelines.
Assist in refining coordination processes as the vertical evolves.
Skills & Competencies
Strong architectural planning and detailing fundamentals
Working knowledge of steel structures or prefabricated systems is mandatory
Excellent coordination and communication abilities
High ownership mindset and accountability
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously
Structured documentation and organizational skills
Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp/Revit/Rhino (BIM familiarity preferred)
Comfort balancing design sensitivity with execution practicality
Education & Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture
45 years of professional experience
Exposure to prefab construction, steel systems, or industrialized building approaches is mandatory
Experience coordinating consultants and site teams
Prior SPOC or coordination-heavy project roles are an advantage
Why Join Verbarq
Opportunity to lead coordination in a growing business vertical
Exposure to architecture integrated with manufacturing and product systems
Direct involvement with leadership and strategic decision-making
Work across full lifecycle delivery from planning to installation
High ownership and growth potential

title: Data Architect
description:
Role Summary
We are looking for an Ontology Data Architect to lead the design, evolution, and operationalisation of our enterprise ontology on the Palantir platform. This role sits at the intersection of business domain knowledge, data engineering, and product delivery. You will shape how real-world operational concepts are represented digitally and ensure the ontology directly enables high-value user journeys, applications, and automation. This is not a theoretical modeling role. Success is measured by adoption, reuse, and business impact.
What You'll Do
Ontology Design & Evolution
Design, own, and evolve a business-driven ontology that represents real operational processes, assets, events, and relationships.
Ensure ontology development is validated through active use in applications, analytics, and workflows.
Balance semantic rigor with pragmatism evolving iteratively based on real use cases.
Product & Platform Collaboration
Work embedded with product teams to co-design ontology elements that support specific user journeys.
Partner with the platform team to shape reusable ontology patterns into shared platform assets.
Ensure product-driven contributions are hardened, standardised, and made reusable across the enterprise.
Domain Translation
Translate domain expert knowledge (often implicit and local) into clear, maintainable ontology structures.
Facilitate lightweight workshops with SMEs to capture meaning without overburdening them.
Resolve ambiguity and inconsistency across sites, systems, and teams.
Data & Platform Integration
Collaborate with data engineers to ensure data pipelines align with ontology semantics.
Guide how raw data is mapped, enriched, and contextualised within the ontology.
Influence data quality, lineage, and governance through semantic design rather than bureaucracy.
Governance & Enablement
Define principles, patterns, and guardrails for ontology usage and extension.
Coach product teams on how to use and extend the ontology safely.
Act as a steward enabling speed without sacrificing coherence.
What We're Looking For
Required Experience
Strong experience in data modelling, semantic modeling, or ontology design in complex domains.
Hands-on experience working with Palantir Foundry ontologies or equivalent semantic platforms.
Proven ability to work closely with business users and product teams, not just engineers.
Experience operating in iterative, product-led environments rather than big- upfront design.
Domain & Mindset
Comfortable navigating messy, real-world operational concepts.
Able to challenge abstract or perfect models in favor of what actually delivers value.
Product mindset: you think in terms of users, outcomes, and adoption.
Nice to Have
Experience in industrial, asset-intensive, or operations-heavy environments.
Background in data engineering, analytics, or platform teams.
Familiarity with governance, metadata, or data catalog concepts without being dogmatic.
How You'll Be Measured
Ontology elements are actively used in applications and workflows.
Product teams can build faster because shared semantic foundations already exist.
Reduced duplication and inconsistency across data and applications.
Clear lineage from business questions ontology data action.
Why This Role Matters
This role is foundational to how we scale insight, automation, and decision-making. You will shape the language of the business, embedded directly into the platform that powers daily operations
